metadata.description: CDR-style conflict detection rules for vector-store memories (embodied agents, RAG memory banks)
metadata.source_paper: Conflict-Aware Memory for Embodied Agents: Enhancing Vector Data Quality via Detection Rules (ACL 2026)

rules.description: Same object, opposing actions, high vector similarity (e.g. 'turn on the light' vs 'turn off the light')
Same object with incompatible states (e.g. 'door is open' vs 'door is closed')
Same object with materially different numeric values
Vector-similar statements that an NLI model judges contradictory (unstructured fallback)
